title: Returning a greeting to a disbeliever
title_arabic: كيف يرد السلام على الكافر إذا سلم
description: How to respond when a disbeliever greets you with Islamic greeting

duas.english: If one of the People of the Scripture (i.e. Christians and Jews) greets you, saying As-Salāmu alaykum, then say (to him): And upon you.
duas.arabic: إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا: وَعَلَيْكُمْ
